_doc: #1547 tier-4 downloadable pack descriptor: the HYG star database (119,614 stars, packed binary; provenance in ac_cloud-nav CREDITS) of Cloud Nav's Space View, not wired into the screen today and kept as a pack so it never ships inside the APK. The blob is fetched on demand from url, verified against bytes + sha256, cached in the app's filesDir and used offline. Regenerate sha256/bytes with: sha256sum data/fleet/packs/hyg-stars.bin (the runtime-data guard fails when they drift).
